name: golden-grids
description: Golden-ratio layout from one model, four platforms: React, React Native, SwiftUI, and Jetpack Compose. Fibonacci-proportioned boxes plus a spiral camera that dials through the layout.

paragraphs: One layout model, four platforms. Golden Grids lays out Fibonacci-proportioned boxes on a golden spiral for React, React Native, SwiftUI, and Jetpack Compose — the same from/to range renders identically on all four, verified against one shared golden master. It ships a spiral camera: a dial that treats the layout as a space you zoom and rotate through rather than a page you scroll past. And there is a live generator — define a range, see it, export it.
Or: How I Learned to Stop Worrying about Rows and Columns and Love the Golden Ratio.

A layout library driven by the Fibonacci sequence. Give it a range and it returns proportionally sized boxes arranged on a golden spiral. It lays out boxes and nothing else — what you put in them is your business, but at least you won't be boring.
